proposed.explanation: Misnames the organization—the correct body is AMCASP, not a general Professional Services Board. Confuses national coordination with MRA-specific oversight—the Philippine Architects Council is not the MRA implementation body. Attributes MRA oversight to a BOA division—AMCASP is the specific body, not a BOA internal division. The ASEAN Monitoring Committee on Architectural Services (AMCASP) was created in the Philippines to serve the Monitoring Committee functions under the MRA. The AMCASP oversees MRA implementation in the Philippines—it reviews ASEAN Architect conduct and reports to the international AAC.
